# Registry

Near-misses and external issues, append only. Kept by the Steward. Checked by E11.

A near-miss is a hazard inside our control: the countermeasure is a redesign that ships
as a check. An external issue is a limitation we cannot redesign: the countermeasure is
a documented workaround.

Copy `docs/templates/registry-entry.md` for each new entry. IDs run RG-001, RG-002 and so
on, ascending without gaps. Anticipatory entries, hazards caught before any failure, are
as welcome as reactive ones.
